description: Clean and normalise messy text before embedding, indexing or prompting: repairs mojibake (UTF-8 read as Windows-1252), strips control and invisible characters (zero-width, bidi overrides used in Trojan Source attacks, soft hyphens, BOM), normalises exotic whitespace, curly quotes, dashes, ligatures and full-width forms, re-joins words hyphenated across line breaks, optionally unwraps hard-wrapped lines, strips HTML, decodes entities, removes emoji / URLs / emails, transliterates to ASCII or lowercases. Reports how many fixes of each kind were made. Offline; 500 KB. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/text-clean

ascii.description: Transliterate Latin accents to ASCII (é -> e)

dehyphenate.description: Join words hyphenated across line breaks (infor-\nmation)

fixMojibake.description: Repair UTF-8 decoded as Windows-1252 (CafÃ© -> Café, â€™ -> ’)

ligatures.description: Expand ﬁ ﬂ ﬀ ﬃ ﬄ ﬅ ﬆ

normalizeDashes.description: En / em / figure dashes and minus sign to "-"

normalizeQuotes.description: Curly quotes / primes to ASCII quotes and … to ...

normalizeWhitespace.description: Tabs and exotic spaces to plain spaces, collapse runs, trim lines, max one blank line

stripControl.description: Remove C0/C1 control characters (keeps tab / newline)

stripInvisible.description: Remove zero-width, bidi override (Trojan Source), soft hyphen and BOM characters

name: text_clean
title: Text Clean
